title: SIP Trunking: Connect ElevenLabs Agents to Your Phone System
desc:
Keep your existing phone system and still put an ElevenLabs voice agent on the line. This episode explains how SIP trunking works, the requirements, the SIP URI format and its most common mistake, every inbound and outbound setting in the import dialog, digest versus ACL authentication, how X- headers become dynamic variables, and the documented fixes for connection, audio and 481 errors.

This episode is a documented walkthrough built from the official ElevenLabs documentation (links below). It does not include a live product recording.
